projects.name: Projects
projects.process_running: A program started from this project is running ({{.Process}}), for example a dev server or a Gradle daemon. Stop it first.
projects.inactive.title: Inactive projects
projects.inactive.what: node_modules, Pods, build, .venv and similar folders in git repositories without commits for more than 30 days.
projects.inactive.why: Only folders that git ignores are listed, so your code and commits are not touched. They are recreated by npm install, pod install or a build.
projects.inactive.after: When you come back to the project, install dependencies or build it again first.
projects.active.title: Active projects
projects.active.what: The same folders in repositories you committed to in the last 30 days.
projects.active.why: They can be recreated too, but you are probably still working on these projects.
projects.active.after: You will need to install dependencies or rebuild before the next run, which takes time.
projects.builds.title: Leftover builds
projects.builds.what: Finished app builds lying next to the code: .xcarchive, .ipa, .apk, .aab, .dmg, .app and installers that git does not track.
projects.builds.why: They are build results, not source code, and can be built again from the project.
projects.builds.after: For an .xcarchive of a version that is live in the App Store, crash reports can no longer be symbolicated on this Mac — keep those.
